verdict.rationale: Otter fires fixed automations on meeting events: auto-joining scheduled meetings, auto-sending transcripts and summaries to Airtable or S3, and pushing action items to Jira, Asana or ClickUp. User-defined rule-to-action logic appears to depend on external tools, namely the Zapier integration and the Otter API & Webhooks. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable rules/trigger builder, documented event types and conditions, and hands-on corroboration of custom automation.
